whyItIsWrong: Most of the work people bring to the platform is not a literature review. A weekly report shaped the same way three times, a script held to the same conventions, a deck always made 16:9 in a dark theme taught the platform nothing: the only way such a preference was kept was a one-line memory, never a method a later run reads before it starts. The loop had two blind spots: a turn of an ordinary conversation left its files where the trigger did not look, and the distillation skill told the model that anything that was not a research practice was not a method.
fix: A turn that produced or changed a file is a delivery lesson whichever record of the ledger the file landed in (leftFiles: artifacts, unverifiedArtifacts, outputFiles); the researcher's corrections stay the strongest signal, with or without a file; an ordinary conversation is not counted as a repeated routine because it has no kind of operation to count over. method-distillation 1.3.0 defines a method as how this person does this kind of work and gives general examples beside the research ones; the platform's delivery bookkeeping is still `no_change`, and a one-off wish is not a method (apps/server/src/learningTriggers.mjs, capabilities/method-distillation/SKILL.md).
